title: Bridging the Gap With My Mother Over Housekeeping
script: Mira: [thoughtful] Mom, I know you mean well, but rearranging my kitchen while I'm at work isn't something I asked for.
Ibu Tuti: I was only trying to help. Everything seemed so disorganized, and it took no time at all to fix.
Mira: [carefully] I understand the intention, truly, but it wasn't disorganized to me, it simply worked differently than your system does.
Ibu Tuti: In my day, a tidy kitchen meant everything had its proper place, visible and easy to reach.
Mira: [reflective] I don't disagree with that in principle, I just need to be the one deciding where things belong in my own home.
Ibu Tuti: I suppose I still think of this as somewhat my responsibility, even though you've had your own place for years now.
Mira: [honestly] That habit makes sense, given how long you looked after everything for all of us growing up.
Ibu Tuti: It's difficult, letting go of that role. Helping felt like the one thing I could still offer easily.
Mira: [gently] You offer plenty, Mom, just not necessarily by rearranging cupboards without mentioning it first.
Ibu Tuti: Fair enough. What would you actually welcome, then, if not reorganizing your kitchen?
Mira: [calmly] Honestly, just visiting, cooking together sometimes, or even just telling me your ideas instead of implementing them while I'm out.
Ibu Tuti: I could do that. Ask first, rather than assume you'd be grateful for the surprise.
Mira: [encouraging] Exactly. And who knows, sometimes I might actually agree with your ideas, once I've had a say in them.
Ibu Tuti: Deal, then. Though I reserve the right to gently mention the spice rack every so often.
Mira: [seriously] Mention away. Just don't rearrange it before I've had my coffee.

quiz.question: What specifically bothered Mira about her mother's visit?
options: Her mother rearranged her kitchen while she was at work, without asking
Her mother criticized her cooking
Her mother stayed too long
Her mother invited guests over
quiz.explanation: Mira explains her mother rearranged the kitchen while she was at work without being asked.

quiz.question: How does Ibu Tuti initially justify her actions?
options: She was bored
Mira had asked her to do it
The kitchen seemed disorganized and it took no time to fix
She wanted to surprise Mira for a birthday
quiz.explanation: Ibu Tuti says the kitchen seemed disorganized and that rearranging it took no time at all.

quiz.question: What deeper reason does Ibu Tuti admit for wanting to help?
options: She has nothing else to do
She dislikes Mira's decorating taste
Helping felt like the one thing she could still offer easily after her caretaking role ended
She wants to move in with Mira
quiz.explanation: Ibu Tuti admits helping felt like the one thing she could still easily offer, tied to her old caretaking role.

quiz.question: What does Mira say she would actually welcome from her mother?
options: More frequent kitchen reorganizing
Financial help
Less contact overall
Visiting, cooking together, or sharing ideas instead of acting on them unasked
quiz.explanation: Mira says she'd welcome visiting, cooking together, or her mother sharing ideas rather than implementing them unasked.

quiz.question: What compromise do they reach by the end?
options: Ibu Tuti will never comment on the kitchen again
Ibu Tuti will ask first instead of assuming, and may still gently mention the spice rack
Mira will let her mother reorganize monthly
They will hire a professional organizer
quiz.explanation: Ibu Tuti agrees to ask first rather than assume, while keeping the right to gently mention things like the spice rack.

quiz.question: Why did Ibu Tuti see the kitchen as her responsibility?
options: Caregiving had defined her role for many years
Mira had asked for daily help
The kitchen belonged to her
She managed the building
quiz.explanation: Letting go of a long family role felt difficult.

quiz.question: What distinction does Mira make about organisation?
options: Visible items are always untidy
Parents should design every kitchen
Coffee determines cupboard order
A different system is not necessarily disorder
quiz.explanation: Her arrangement worked even if it differed from her mother's.

quiz.question: Why does Mira acknowledge her mother's intention?
options: She agrees the kitchen was disorganised
She wants a boundary without rejecting the relationship
She plans to move home
She needs housekeeping lessons
quiz.explanation: Mira validates care while protecting authority over her home.

quiz.question: What kind of help would respect Mira's autonomy?
options: Rearrange cupboards during work
Replace every spice container
Visit only when invited to clean
Offer ideas and wait for permission
quiz.explanation: Asking first turns surprise action into collaboration.

quiz.question: What does the spice-rack joke show at the end?
options: The conflict remains unresolved
They can keep warmth while holding the boundary
Ibu Tuti refuses to change
Mira dislikes all advice
quiz.explanation: Humour follows a clear agreement to ask before acting.
